## What's new

- Logins you add or change in another Bitwarden app now show in Bitlatch without pressing Refresh. Opening the browser popup, searching in Raycast, or focusing the Bitlatch window pulls the latest vault when the last sync is more than 30 seconds old.
- The browser popup shows those changes as soon as the background sync finishes.

Everything from [v0.3.8](https://github.com/dillionverma/bitlatch/releases/tag/v0.3.8) is included.

## Downloads

- **Desktop:** macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon), Windows (x64), Linux (x64 / ARM64).
- **Extensions:** Chrome / Chromium, Firefox preview, and Raycast source ZIP.

Download packages and checksums from **Assets** below. Requires the official Bitwarden CLI. [Setup](https://github.com/dillionverma/bitlatch#installation).

Preview: macOS is not notarized; Windows is unsigned; Windows and Linux are experimental. Auto-lock defaults to **15 minutes**; change it in Settings.
